title.narrative: Multi-sectoral Emergency Response to Support Drought and Conflict Affected Communities in Harunka Woreda Zone 3, Afar Regional State.

description.narrative: ltpgtASDEPO is proposing an integrated multi-sectoral emergency response project targeting conflict affected IDPs and host communities in Harunka woredas Zone 3 Afar Regional State. The proposed project intends to scale up ASDEPO’s ongoing humanitarian response activities in the woreda which targets IDPs and host communities. Through this project, ASDEO will support the IDPs and host communities in Harunka woredas who are in need of immediate lifesaving humanitarian support. The project integrates Health, WaSH, nutrition and agriculture response. The project is planned to be implemented in collaboration with Nexus Ethiopia and HEKS as sub-IPs who have sectorial expertise on WaSH and health. On the other hand, ASDEPO will also manage the implementation of nutrition and agriculture activities. Protection will also be mainstreamed across the thematic sectors to prevent and respond GBV, Priority for PwD and vulnerable groups. strengthen the sector specific needs. The proposed activities and the proportion of budget allocation for each sector is based on the woreda level needs informed by the multi sectoral assessment conducted for Zone 3 in general and Harunka Woreda in particular. The project integrates immediate lifesaving response activities and durable solutions that contribute for the recovery and resilience of the target populations. Key cross cutting areas are meaningfully mainstreamed across the project activities and reasonable resource is allocated for cross cutting activities. The project will be implemented in close collaboration and complementarity among the implementing partners and the government stakeholders. As part of the localization of aid efforts, ASDEPO is demonstrating strong capacities to enhance the organizational capacity of Nexus Ethiopia. It will scale up its good practices and closely collaborate towards the attainment of the project objectives. ASDEPO and the sub-IPs will ensure proper monitoring and evaluation activities to inform program management decisions with evidence from the field. Government counterparts will also conduct joint monitoring sessions periodically. ASDEPO and the implementing partners are active in the cluster system at national and sub-national level. The coordination and reporting of project activities to the donor and the clusters via Activityinfo will be strengthened. The project duration is 10 months for health and WASH as well as 12 months for nutrition and agriculture. The total budget of the project is 1,000,000 USD. Through this budget the project will directly reach 23,803 people in need in the woreda of which 58% are female and 31% are children as well as 42% are male. ltbrgtlt/pgt
